extensionDescription.message: Shows when your requests go through an intermediary that decrypts them, such as Cloudflare, Akamai or Imperva.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

titleNeutral.message: No request of this tab goes through a known intermediary.
titleNeutral.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when no request of the tab goes through a known provider.

titleNotObserved.message: Site not observed: the extension's access to this site was withdrawn, it can say nothing about it.
titleNotObserved.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when the extension has no access to the site of the tab and saw nothing.

titleLevel2.message: Level 2, usage: $PROVIDER$ sees which public resources this site makes you load, and when.
titleLevel2.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, blue, level 2.

titleLevel3Unproven.message: Level 3, reading, decryption not proven: the pages you read go through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel3Unproven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, orange, level 3.

titleLevel3Proven.message: Level 3, reading, decryption proven: the pages you read go in clear through $PROVIDER$.
titleLevel3Proven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, red, level 3.

titleLevel4DataSentUnproven.message: Level 4, personal data, data sent, decryption not proven: what you send to this site goes through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel4DataSentUnproven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, orange, level 4, case of a request that sends data.

titleLevel4DataSentProven.message: Level 4, personal data, data sent, decryption proven: what you send to this site goes in clear through $PROVIDER$.
titleLevel4DataSentProven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, red, level 4, case of a request that sends data.

titleLevel4SessionUnproven.message: Level 4, personal data, session, decryption not proven: your session on this site goes through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel4SessionUnproven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, orange, level 4, case of a request that carries an Authorization header.

titleLevel4SessionProven.message: Level 4, personal data, session, decryption proven: your session on this site goes in clear through $PROVIDER$.
titleLevel4SessionProven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, red, level 4, case of a request that carries an Authorization header.

titleLevel4SessionPossibleUnproven.message: Level 4, personal data, possible session, decryption not proven: the cookies you send to this site, perhaps a session, go through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel4SessionPossibleUnproven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, orange, level 4, case of a request that carries cookies of the site.

titleLevel4SessionPossibleProven.message: Level 4, personal data, possible session, decryption proven: the cookies you send to this site, perhaps a session, go in clear through $PROVIDER$.
titleLevel4SessionPossibleProven.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, red, level 4, case of a request that carries cookies of the site.

titleAntiBot.message: Anti-bot: this request belongs to the anti-bot protection of $PROVIDER$, not to the site you visit.
titleAntiBot.description: Sentence added to the tooltip when the most serious request belongs to the anti-bot machinery of the provider.

titlePartial.message: Partial view: the extension has no access to every site of this tab, it shows what it saw.
titlePartial.description: Sentence added to the tooltip when the extension has no access to a site of the tab.
